collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: An elder poses a riddle to the children gathered by the fire.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), an elder, poses a riddle to the children gathered by the fire. The youngest child answers it correctly, to everyone's surprise.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), an elder, poses a riddle to the children gathered by the fire. The children argue over the answer long after the elder has gone to bed.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), an elder, poses a riddle to the children gathered by the fire. The elder admits they have forgotten the answer themselves.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1), an elder, poses a riddle to the children gathered by the fire. One child invents a riddle in return that stumps the elder completely.
